title: Heavy hitters: sketch vs exact vs store and query (real collector containers)

panels.title: Three approaches to the same question: which routes are heavy hitters, and which are new?

answer: method="raw"

Every stage is one pinned container. Traffic grows over 30 minutes: the rate per source doubles every 5 minutes (5k to 80k points/s), /new/hot-route takes 15% of traffic at minute 10, and the number of routes grows from 100,000 to 1,000,000 at minute 15. hh-accuracy compares the sketch with exact; query-job compares store and query with exact and times every approach's backend query.
